title: Email/Password Account Lifecycle
notes: Identity products differ in CIAM/local-user details; provider choice remains contestable.

provider_tools.label: Amazon Cognito User Pools
provider_tools.notes: Managed user-pool service for local account lifecycle.

provider_tools.label: Firebase Authentication
provider_tools.notes: Firebase Auth supports managed users and account operations.

provider_tools.label: Microsoft Entra External ID
provider_tools.notes: CIAM identity product; some user-management calls use Microsoft Graph.

provider_tools.label: Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM
provider_tools.notes: Use IDaaS EIAM rather than RAM SSO for app-user identity.

provider_tools.label: IBM Cloud App ID
provider_tools.notes: Supplementary IBM option; App ID integration is more REST/protocol driven.

neutral_tools.label: Auth0
neutral_tools.notes: Independent CIAM provider for account lifecycle.
